name: vix_spike_mean_reversion
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, a rapid 5%+ surge in India VIX within 10 minutes forces options market makers to delta-hedge aggressively by selling NIFTY futures, simultaneously triggering stop-loss cascades on leveraged long positions — pushing NIFTY 20-50 spot points below session VWAP. India VIX is the 30-day implied vol of NIFTY itself, so once VIX stabilizes (stops making new highs), the delta-hedge selling pressure dissipates, and resting buy orders accumulated below VWAP absorb remaining supply in a sharp 30-90 second reversion. At 5-second resolution we can detect the moment VIX stops rising (prior 30-second VIX delta ≤ 0) while the 10-minute spike is still active, entering the very first bar of the mean reversion rather than waiting for a full 1-minute bar confirmation.

indicators.name: vix_spike_120
indicators.purpose: 120 bars = 10 minutes, identical time window to original (FIXED TIME WINDOW, not scaled). VIX spike detection requires the full 10-minute context — a shorter window would fire on noise; longer would miss the sharp structural spikes that create exploitable oversells. This is the primary regime gating condition.

indicators.name: vix_stabilizing_6
indicators.purpose: 6 bars = 30 seconds. New to this 5s conversion: we don't want to enter while VIX is still surging (delta-hedging still accelerating). A 30-second plateau/drop signals the first wave of forced selling is exhausted. Original 1-min bars couldn't distinguish 'spike ongoing' vs 'spike peak' within the same bar — at 5s we can.

indicators.name: rsi_36
indicators.purpose: 36 bars = 3 minutes. Original was RSI(14) on 1-min bars = 14 minutes of data. Compressed to 3 minutes because we are targeting the FAST reversion (30-90s hold), not the slow recovery (15-45 min). A 3-min RSI dropping below 35 on NIFTY signals the acute oversold state driven by the VIX-spike selling wave, not a structural downtrend. Using 14-minute RSI at 5s resolution would be too slow to trigger during the fleeting reversion window.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative from session open — no lookback scaling needed. NIFTY spot below VWAP during a VIX spike confirms the institutional benchmark has been violated, making VWAP-benchmarked algorithms (dominant in NIFTY futures) net buyers as they accumulate at a discount to their benchmark.

conditions: vix_stabilizing_6 == True (VIX not making new 30s highs)
buy_ce.confirmation: All four conditions true simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

buy_pe.confirmation: Overbought on NIFTY during VIX spike — possible when VIX spike is fear-driven but NIFTY lags before reversing down; rarer but captures that scenario

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points = ~10 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. If NIFTY moves 10 more spot points against us after VIX has stabilized, the spike is extending into a sustained trend (regime change), not a mean reversion — the thesis is invalidated. Based on 30s typical move of 2-5 pts: stop is roughly 1.5x typical adverse move before reversion.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option points = ~16 NIFTY spot points. VIX-spike-driven NIFTY overshoots typically retrace 20-35 spot points in the first reversion leg; capturing 16 pts (~50% of the lower bound) at 1:1.6 R:R. Calibrated to 60-90 second hold where 1-min typical move is 3-7 pts — 8 is at the upper end, justified by the above-average directional impulse following VIX stabilization.

filters.vix_filter: Embedded in entry — vix_spike_120 >= 0.05 is the primary filter; baseline VIX level irrelevant, only the spike magnitude matters
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST; 09:25 start ensures 10-min VIX lookback is populated before signals fire
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is structural noise; VIX spike is the cleanest volume proxy
filters.trend_filter: vwap position acts as trend filter: below VWAP required for long, above VWAP for short
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — structural microstructure constraint tied to VIX regime; survives as long as NIFTY options market makers delta-hedge via futures

adaptation_notes: Three core changes from original: (1) Universe shifted from 50 NIFTY stocks to the NIFTY index itself — actually strengthens the mechanism since VIX IS NIFTY's IV, making the delta-hedge link direct rather than indirect. (2) RSI period compressed from 14min to 3min (36 bars) to catch the fast oversold at 5s resolution; we're targeting the first 30-90s reversion, not the 15-45min recovery. (3) Added vix_stabilizing_6 indicator (not in original) — the 5s resolution enables us to detect the VIX spike peak within 30 seconds, entering the reversion at the optimal moment rather than waiting for a full 1-min confirmation bar. VWAP reference and VIX spike threshold (5% over 10 min) kept identical to original.
weaknesses: VIX spikes preceding sustained crashes (2020 COVID, 2008) will result in multiple stop-outs before the signal quiets — max_trades_per_day=4 limits damage
India VIX at 5-second resolution may have stale prints during low-liquidity periods, producing false stabilization signals
Rare event: 2-4 qualifying signals per day on average; strategy may have long drawdown periods with zero trades
